figurative_meaning_en: To scratch and bite each other, causing wounds and damage
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই বোন ছিঁড়াছিঁড়ি করে লড়াই করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The two sisters are fighting tooth and nail.
The neighbors tore into each other in a heated argument.
note: Onomatopoeic reduplication evoking sounds of tearing or scratching in fights
